name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (battle/chars domain). Name accurately reflects the body: masks each runtime_char.bFlags with 0x7F, clearing bit 0x80 (the acted-this-turn flag) for all battle party members. No Ghidra address residue in the name. void(void), no params.
purpose: Reset the acted-this-turn flag (bFlags bit 0x80) on every battle party member at a turn boundary or chapter init/end, so all characters may act again.
logic_summary: for (i = 0; i < data_fd2_battle_party_member_count; i++) data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[i].bFlags &= 0x7F; Disassembly confirms AND byte [base + i*0x50 + 5], 0x7F (offset +5 = bFlags, stride 0x50 = RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE). The PUSH 0x8 / CALL __CHK(8) is the compiler-injected Watcom stack-probe prologue; the in_stack_* vars in the decomp are artifacts of that probe, not real locals.
writes_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[i].bFlags (mutates array elements via the pointer; the pointer itself is not reassigned)
comment_original_issue: src comment block (btl_init.c lines 377-387) was already precise and correct (states bit 0x80 / +0x05 / mask 0x7F / 4 callers); kept unchanged.
notes: Callers: fd2_run_full_turn_cycle (2 sites: Phase D enemy-turn open, Phase F new-player-turn), fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, fd2_chapter_10_end, fd2_chapter_20_end. RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50=80 confirmed via runtime_char struct layout (size 80, bFlags at offset +5). src uses runtime_char struct field .flags (offset +5, same as Ghidra struct bFlags). Ghidra plate originally read 'Clear bFlags & 0x7F (bit 0x80)' which risks misreading (it retains the low 7 bits, not clears them); refined plate to the src's clearer wording. No src Edit needed (comment kept), so only the shard is staged.
